readings.moment: When the temple struck nine, Uncle Aurèle had the watches put on the cloth
When the temple struck nine (Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine)
When the temple struck ten, Félix was in the library
When the temple struck ten (Félix's watch showed twenty to ten)
At a quarter past ten, someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door
At twenty-one minutes past ten, someone came quickly down the stairs
At eighteen minutes past ten, Félix heard a thump on the floor above him in the atelier
After the thump, the uncle's repeater sounded ten slow deep notes
At thirty-two minutes past ten, Bastien Girard came into the library
The temple struck eleven, when Girard and Félix stopped sitting together in the library

durations: Bastien Girard sat with Félix in the library from 10:32 until the temple struck eleven, about 28 minutes
whereabouts: Dinner took place with Uncle Aurèle, Aunt Odile, Girard, and Félix present; the watches were put on the cloth at nine
Uncle Aurèle held Félix's watch up in front of everyone at dinner
Aunt Odile did not look up at dinner
Girard and Uncle Aurèle quarrelled about the price of the repeater's rights at dinner
After dinner Félix went up to the library with the brandy bottle and sat there alone
Aunt Odile was at the piano downstairs at ten o'clock
Aunt Odile's piano was playing downstairs when the thump was heard
Félix was alone in the library from after dinner until Girard came in
Someone went up the stairs past the library door at a quarter past ten; Félix did not see who
Someone came down the stairs at twenty-one minutes past ten; Félix did not see who and did not go out to look
The thump came from the atelier, directly above the library
Bastien Girard came into the library at 10:32 and stayed until the temple struck eleven
